mods.description: Compact conduits, painted things and all sorts of stuff and bling. This is the monolithic jar, containing all core modules.

releases.notes:
## Ender IO 9.0.6-alpha

Quick 1.21.1 parity release.

### Features

#### From 1.21.1

- Added tooltips to item, fluid and redstone filter slots
- Travel anchors render full-block icons as blocks instead of items
- Crowdin translation updates

### Bug Fixes

- Missing textures/models for dark steel ladder, end/dark steel bars and soul chain

#### From 1.21.1

- Coldfire not going out or generating grains
- Prevent powered spawner putting too many items in the output
- Avoid crashes when checking for valid souls
- ~~ME conduit not listening for capability invalidation~~
- Conduit inventories not dropping if the last conduit in a bundle is broken
- Farming station GUI background width incorrect
- Prevent self-feeding energy conduits
- Farming station blocks when out of seeds, even when there are other tasks to perform
- ~~Machines can dupe items under specific conditions~~

### Experiments

Experiments are new features locked behind feature flags, these are work-in-progress and shouldn't be enabled on your primary world.

- The Ender IO
  - Early work in progress
